answer: A farm of 146 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are entered in pulse, queued in oasis, and vertex publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 85 identities per epoch. A farm of 3589 identities would post 882 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
